prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean an indoor UV (beds) tanning salon or a spray/tanning booth (airbrush or automated)? “Best” depends on which service you want, your neighborhood, budget, and whether you value speed vs. a custom, natural-looking result.

Before I pull up current top-rated salons for you, a few quick tips to help pick the best one:

- Decide spray vs. UV: spray (sunless) is the safer option — no UV exposure. If you want a UV tan, be aware of skin-cancer risks and check that the salon follows safety rules and inspects skin/limits sessions.
- Read recent local reviews (Google, Yelp, Facebook) and look for before/after photos.
- For spray tans, prefer salons that use reputable solutions (Norvell, VersaSpa, Mystic, etc.), offer custom color matching, and have trained technicians who do a consultation.
- For UV tanning, check that the machines are well-maintained and that staff advise on skin type, session length, and protective eyewear.
- Ask about hygiene, booth/bed cleanliness, patch-test policies (for first-time spray clients), and cancellation/no-show policies.
- Request technician portfolios or Instagram before/afters for spray tans to judge naturalness and skill.

If you want, I can look up current top-rated tanning salons in Charlotte, NC and give a short list (spray vs. UV, addresses, hours, and highlights). Which type are you looking for and any neighborhood preference?
